verdict.rationale: Munito AI states on its homepage that it is "Private by default, zero data retention. No training on your data." Customer data is excluded from training by default, with no opt-out step required, and llms.txt repeats the "private by default" positioning. Missing for 10: detailed first-party policy or terms documentation on training exclusion, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond a marketing-page claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
